# PROMPTS.md — "Think one step ahead"

**No generation prompts.** No text, image, or audio was generated by AI for
this package. Narration and scene code were authored by hand; Kokoro TTS
rendering happens on Bear's Mac at render time (see CLAUDE-CODE-RENDER.md).

## The viewer's prompt (BHTF, read in full on screen)

> I'm weighing a decision: [describe it in two sentences]. First, think it
> through step by step on your scratchpad: list what matters, try each side,
> and note anything I should double-check. Only then give me your take — and
> tell me what I would need next if I follow your advice.

## The viewer's two self-checks (BHTF output lines)

1. Run it once more without the "think it through first" line. Does the answer change?
2. Look for the moment it changed its mind on the scratchpad. That crossed-out
   idea is the thinking doing the work.
